title: Susan McCasland's 911 call about her husband

tellings.quote: I have some indication that he must have planned not to be found.

plain: In 2026, in Albuquerque, New Mexico, a woman named Susan McCasland called 911, the US emergency number, about her missing husband and told them, "I have some indication that he must have planned not to be found." Her own words come from the recording of that call. The story is told in an episode about top American scientists who have gone missing.
